reviews.title: Do not spend money!
reviews.text:
This game offers a wide selection of games and offers to make a few extra bucks. The rewards are minimal compared to similar apps unless you invest significant time or money into them, but easy to use and payout.

I have had significant issues, however, with the app properly tracking milestones. When I submit a ticket it is generally never answered without a follow up. Recently, I’ve had an issue with several hundred dollars worth of milestones not being tracked. I finally got in touch with a real human, and gave them as much proof as possible of my gameplay. That was almost a week ago, and have heard nothing back at all despite multiple attempts to follow up. Customer service and app accuracy leaves much  to be desired.

Update:
I have continued to be ignored regarding my previous ticket. I decided to give it another go with a different offer. This time I was forced to screen record all of my gameplay within the app, for fear I wouldn’t be credited again and expected to provide proof. When I was again not credited and submitted a ticket again, I was promptly suspended, on some ridiculous claim that I had breached terms of use. I read through the entire terms and conditions. I didn’t. Not in any way, shape or form.

I was idiotic enough to spend money to complete tasks recently, and now I’m out a considerable amount of money. Don’t use any money on here you can’t afford to lose. Chances are you might.

If you use it to make $2 or $3 you’re probably fine.. but watch out if you make anything of substance. This company seems shady at best if not outright fraudulent.

I have walked over 13,000 steps today, yet once again I am being told that if I want to get them credited, I have to do other tasks. This is neither fair nor right, given how they promote themselves on their app download page. It is just anither totally lying BS fake app. Don’t waste your time with them, but then again I haven’t come across even one other steps app that credits you fairly or accurately for the amount of time you put in walking each day. If they did, I would be making a fair amount, but they literally give you like five cents for 5000 steps — so it’s really not worth it.

reviews.title: Scrambly Suspended My Account After I Reached Level 35 and Now Says Support May Take Weeks
reviews.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with my experience with Scrambly.

I spent an entire day legitimately playing a game and worked all the way up to Level 35. As soon as I reached a major milestone and was getting close to being able to cash out, my account was suddenly suspended. The reason given was related to VPN usage and/or having multiple accounts. I do not use a VPN, I do not have multiple accounts, and I have not done anything to manipulate the system.

What makes this even more frustrating is that this has happened to me before. I previously had my account suspended after reaching a certain milestone, and now I’m experiencing the same issue again.

I contacted support expecting the issue to be investigated, but the response I received basically told me that it could take “a few weeks” for someone to even respond because their support team is overwhelmed.

I understand that a company can grow quickly and that support can become busy, but suspending someone’s account and potentially holding their earned rewards while making them wait weeks for an investigation is extremely frustrating.

People are spending hours completing these offers based on the expectation that they will receive the rewards they earned. If Scrambly’s system flags legitimate users, there needs to be a better process for quickly reviewing and correcting those mistakes.

I’m not saying everyone will have the same experience, but based on my experience, I would be very cautious about investing a lot of time into high-level game offers until Scrambly improves its account review and support process.

I’m hoping Scrambly actually reviews my account and resolves this rather than leaving me waiting weeks after I’ve already spent hours completing their offers.
